traits.name: Earth Glide
traits.text:
The elemental can burrow through non
magical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so,
the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves
through.

actions.name: Slam

one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
